title: Performance guarantees: checks before the contract
excerpt: A preparation checklist for Moldovan contractors: beneficiary requirements, amount, validity and conditions of a performance guarantee.
imageAlt: Two specialists checking building work at a construction site
author: ING Broker editorial team

seo.title: Performance guarantees in Moldova: contract checks | ING Broker
seo.description: Prepare beneficiary wording, amount, currency, validity and project records before assessing a performance guarantee. Distinguish it from CAR/EAR insurance.
seo.keywords: performance guarantee Moldova, contractual guarantees, construction contractors, beneficiary requirements, guarantee validity

content:
A performance guarantee is assessed against contractual obligations and beneficiary requirements. It is not insurance for damage at a construction site. Before asking for an offer, check the accepted guarantee form, eligible issuer and required wording.

Start with the beneficiary's documents

For a construction company or service provider, a cheap guarantee that is not contractually acceptable does not solve the need. In public procurement in the Republic of Moldova, check the form of guarantee and accepted issuer against the procedure's documentation, with support from a specialist in the applicable legal framework.

  1. Extract the guarantee clause from the contract and retain any mandatory wording template.
  2. Record amount, currency, beneficiary and guaranteed obligations.
  3. Separate the period for carrying out the work from the period for remedying defects.
  4. Check extension, reduction and release.
  5. Ask about payment demands and possible reimbursement obligations towards the issuer.

What the issuer needs to assess

Prepare the contract, work schedule, experience with comparable projects, financial statements and commitments already undertaken. Request the document list and any counter-security requirements in writing. Do not assume these requirements are absent merely because an insurer issues the instrument. They need to be understood separately from the price quoted for the guarantee.

Who checks the final version?

Establish who confirms contract details, who checks the form requested by the beneficiary and who retains the final version. Each person holding a copy received at a different time is insufficient. Before submission, compare the amount, currency, parties and validity with the current documentation. Request correction or explanation of any difference before presenting the document as accepted.

Which problem does the requested document solve?

At the start of a project, a contractor may receive several requirements: site insurance, third-party liability and a performance guarantee. These documents are not interchangeable. For the first discussion, copy the exact contractual requirement into an internal sheet and keep the source document. Do not rename it construction insurance where the beneficiary requests an instrument with a different purpose.

Check whether a mandatory template exists and who may issue it. Acceptance of a guarantee form cannot be inferred from an article or its use by a provider on another project. For Moldovan procurement and other procedures with special requirements, seek legal review of the actual documentation. This material provides a preparation method, not confirmation that a particular issuer is admissible.

Seven contract details to prepare

A well-prepared request helps identify differences before issue. Use the updated contract and its annexes, not only an older commercial quotation. If amendments have been signed, highlight what changed. Do not send two versions with different amounts or periods without explaining their relationship. The team needs one clear basis for the proposed instrument.

  1. Exact beneficiary and contractor names.
  2. The obligation requiring a guarantee.
  3. Amount, currency and calculation basis.
  4. Requested commencement and expiry.
  5. Mandatory wording where applicable.
  6. Extension, reduction and release conditions.
  7. Who can confirm acceptance of the proposed form.

Do not invent a standard percentage of the work's value. Where an amount follows a contractual formula, retain that formula and the checked calculation. If information is ambiguous, mark the question for the beneficiary and legal specialist. An instrument issued on an assumption may fail the actual requirement regardless of the price paid.

Track execution and defect periods separately

Prepare a timeline beginning with the relevant contract date and continuing through execution, acceptance and any later obligations. Do not assume they all end on the same day. Record where the contract uses fixed dates and where it refers to events such as acceptance. Ask how those milestones are reflected in the proposed instrument.

If work is delayed, an updated internal schedule alone does not establish extension of the guarantee. Check the procedure with the issuer and beneficiary before expiry. Keep confirmations and signed versions. This article sets no universal validity period and does not replace assessment of the dates and deadlines in your actual contract.

Why the contractor's financial position matters

Prepare the requested financial documents and an overview of ongoing projects. Separate signed contracts from tender participation and work that is only estimated. Explain existing commitments, resources and the schedules of major projects. A table combining opportunities with certain revenue without distinction can create an inaccurate picture of the company's capacity to fulfil its commitments.

The issuer establishes the final document list and acceptance conditions. Questions about counter-security or reimbursement obligations must be explained before commitments are undertaken. Do not present an insurer-issued guarantee as an instrument with no financial consequences for the contractor. Read all undertakings, not only the cost and amount stated in the document intended for the beneficiary.

Do not copy bid guarantees into performance guarantees

A requirement for tender participation and a requirement for contract performance have different timing and subjects that must be identified separately. Do not reuse an old template merely by changing its title. Compare the beneficiary, obligation, amount, validity and conditions for a payment demand. Where separate forms exist in the procedure documents, keep each with its instructions.

For a project also requiring CAR/EAR, meaning construction or erection insurance, prepare a table of documents. Put the contractual requirement in one column and the document intended to meet it in another. Mark unresolved or unconfirmed points. Do not expect a site certificate to replace a distinct guarantee through wording alone.

Compare more than cost

Use the same contract and beneficiary template for both assessments. Compare differences in wording, not only the amount. A proposal containing an extra condition may differ from the requested document even when the title is identical. Ask for marked changes, explanations and confirmation of acceptance before reaching the submission deadline.

Also compare the documents the contractor signs: obligations, costs, extension requirements and any additional undertakings. Separate the fee or premium from other sums that may be requested. Do not treat a verbal estimate as a final offer. An informed decision requires clarity about both the beneficiary's document and the obligations undertaken by your own company.

Illustrative change before issue

In an illustrative example, the beneficiary extends execution and changes the work's value through an amendment. The contractor has a proposal prepared for the original version. Compare the new value, dates, obligations and required form with the proposed document. Do not assume the period is the only relevant change. This example describes no client and confirms no conditions available from a particular insurer.

The project manager and document administrator must use the same version. Name internal files by contract, date and version without publicly exposing confidential information. Before signing, check party identities and transcription errors. A similarly named company must not be confused with the beneficiary identified in the contract.

When a demand or disagreement arises

Retain the received demand, communication date and attachments. Follow the instrument and seek legal assistance for actual rights and duties. Do not promise acceptance or refusal of payment on the issuer's behalf. The broker can facilitate communication but does not replace issuer decisions or legal dispute resolution.

Separate discussion of the work's progress from the guarantee's documentary procedure. Even while the parties discuss remedial work, check applicable notices and deadlines in the actual documents in parallel. Do not infer from commercial negotiations that every other obligation is suspended. This article sets no litigation steps and reaches no conclusion on a particular demand.

A useful file until project closure

Keep the contract, annexes, issued guarantee, evidence of delivery and correspondence about changes. Add acceptance and release documents as applicable. The responsible person should quickly identify the latest version and remaining open issues. A copy once sent through messaging is not a sufficiently clear record for the whole project period.

At completion, check which document confirms discharge of the obligation and what steps the actual instrument requires. Do not assume finishing the work automatically ends all commitments. Reuse the question list for future projects, but not conditions without checking. Every beneficiary, contract and issuer needs separate assessment in the Republic of Moldova.

Frequently asked questions about performance guarantees

Is this the same as CAR/EAR insurance?

Do not treat these documents as interchangeable. Ask for the obligation to perform the contract to be distinguished from material risks affecting the works and liability towards third parties.

Can a bank guarantee be replaced without beneficiary agreement?

Do not assume acceptance. Check the contractual documents, applicable legal requirements and confirmation from the beneficiary before the proposed instrument is issued.

What if the work period is extended?

Report the change in advance and request the procedure applicable to the existing guarantee. Extension of the commercial contract alone does not establish extension of the guarantee instrument.

Next step
